name: Ondu Rising and Battle Cry — "Whenever a creature attacks / blocks this turn, it …" on the picked creatures
notes: Sweep group 7 (2026-10-07). Same unread wording as Song of Blood; neither spell did anything. Ondu Rising gives the picked attacker lifelink; Battle Cry gives the picked blocker +0/+1.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Ondu Rising
